name: Plozz
tagline: Free, open-source native Apple TV, iOS, and iPadOS app for Jellyfin, Plex, Emby,
description: Free, open-source native Apple TV, iOS, and iPadOS app for Jellyfin, Plex, Emby, and local shares (SMB, NFS, WebDAV, SFTP, FTP). Stream your movies, shows, and music on all devices with auto skip, full subtitle support, dark/light modes, customizable UI, multi-server sync, supports all trackers (Last.fm, AniList, MyAnimeList, Trakt, Simkl).
